$comment: Hand-maintained semantic-motion review record. Read by scripts/motion-inventory.mjs, which derives everything else (catalog, recipe, mapping source) from the code. Grades: A strongly semantic · B semantic family · C acceptable generic · D weak / generic fallback · E wrong semantics. An icon's grade is the weaker of its outline and filled grades. Only record what was actually inspected; see docs/ai/MOTION-INVENTORY.md for the method.

before.note: Whole glyph hops 6px up and back; nothing opens.

folder-open.story: The front panel starts stood up (closed) and falls forward onto the drawing's open pose; the back panel never moves.

filled.evidence: filmstrip 16/24/48px, 2026-11-04 (front panel is its own subpath)

before.note: Whole glyph hops; the plus is static relative to the folder.

folder-plus.story: The plus turns in from a point and lands with a small overshoot; the folder stays put.

filled.evidence: filmstrip 24px, 2026-11-04 — the plus is an evenodd hole, so the folder swells (gains) instead

before.note: Whole glyph hops; the minus is static relative to the folder.

folder-minus.story: The minus collapses to a point (taken out) and springs back; the folder stays put.

outline.evidence: filmstrip 16/24/48px, 2026-11-04 — the mark acts, but a round-trip collapse only implies removal

filled.evidence: filmstrip 16/24/48px, 2026-11-04 — the minus is an evenodd hole, so the folder contracts instead

before.note: Whole glyph hops up — against the direction the arrow means.

folder-arrow-down.story: The arrow is drawn down from above the folder into it, then the head resolves; the folder takes a slight impact.

filled.evidence: filmstrip 24px, 2026-11-04 — the arrow is an evenodd hole, so the folder squashes on arrival instead

inbox.story: The tray floor drops in from the tray mouth, narrowed to stay between the walls, and lands; the tray takes the weight.

outline.evidence: filmstrip 24px, 2026-11-04 — the floor line stands in for the received content

filled.evidence: filmstrip 24px, 2026-11-04 — the cavity is an evenodd hole, so the tray squashes instead

before.note: Whole glyph hops up — against the direction the arrow means.

inbox-arrow-down.story: The arrow is drawn down into the tray through the gap in its rim; the tray takes a small impact.

before.note: Borrowed folder hop; the stack moves as one block.

inbox-stack.story: The lower tray rises into place, then the upper tray is set down on it and the lower one takes the weight.

filled.evidence: filmstrip 16/24/48px, 2026-11-04 (each tray is its own tag)

before.note: Whole glyph fades in from fully invisible.

clipboard.story: The clip springs open, holds, and snaps shut on the board.

filled.evidence: filmstrip 16/24/48px, 2026-11-04 — the clip's opening is an evenodd hole, so the board squashes instead

before.note: Whole glyph fades in from fully invisible.

clipboard-document.story: The clip opens, the document slides under it and is pinned as the clip snaps shut.

filled.evidence: filmstrip 24px, 2026-11-04 — document placed onto the board (clip is part of the board's compound path)

before.note: Whole glyph fades in from fully invisible.

clipboard-document-list.story: Each row checks in, in order: its bullet pops, then its line is written.

filled.evidence: filmstrip 16/24/48px, 2026-11-04 — rows are evenodd holes in the document, so the document is placed onto the board instead

before.note: Whole glyph fades in from fully invisible.

file.story: The sheet is drawn, then its dog-ear folds down from the corner.

newspaper.story: The photo block is placed, then the columns are set line by line.
